why_choose.title: Clarity in Compliance. Confidence in Every Audit.
why_choose.subtitle: We provide practical, transparent support designed to simplify complex statutory obligations and international assessment protocols.
why_choose.card1_desc: Actionable, ground-level advisory that addresses actual shop-floor situations rather than theoretical interpretations.
why_choose.card2_desc: Structured filing, meticulous register maintenance, and complete compliance dossiers ready for immediate inspection.
why_choose.card3_desc: Deep familiarity with international buyer expectations, codes of conduct, and social accountability frameworks.
why_choose.card4_desc: Targeted root-cause analysis and sustainable corrective and preventive action plans (CAP) to close audit findings.
why_choose.card5_desc: Domain expertise tailored to the unique workflow, labor patterns, and supply-chain pressures of the textile and garment sectors.
why_choose.card6_desc: Clear, responsive, and ethical client liaison throughout preparation, mock audits, and post-assessment follow-up.

process.title: Our Working Process
process.subtitle: A structured 4-step framework engineered for seamless compliance organisation and audit preparedness.
process.step1_desc: Understand the client's facility, applicable compliance requirements, buyer expectations and service needs.
process.step2_desc: Review available documentation, workplace practices and potential compliance gaps through meticulous pre-assessment.
process.step3_desc: Support documentation improvements, corrective actions, worker record rectifications, and comprehensive audit preparation.
process.step4_desc: Help track action items, maintain updated registers, and prepare for applicable ongoing compliance requirements.

founder.title: Meet the Founder
founder.name: KHIBDHIYA I
founder.bio_p1: KHIBDHIYA I is the founder of KIA ASSOCIATE, a compliance consultancy focused on statutory compliance, labour-law requirements, factory compliance, social compliance and international buyer audit support.
founder.bio_p2: Currently pursuing a Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.), she is building a forward-looking business with a vision to make compliance support more accessible, organised and approachable for factories, textile manufacturers, garment exporters and supply-chain businesses.
founder.bio_p3: Through KIA ASSOCIATE, she aims to help businesses better understand compliance requirements, prepare for assessments and strengthen responsible workplace practices.
founder.quote: “Compliance is not merely about passing an audit — it is about building enduring business credibility, safe workplaces, and trusted supply chains.”

privacy_modal.title: Privacy Policy & Client Confidentiality
privacy_modal.p1: At KIA ASSOCIATE, we treat all client facility records, payroll data, audit reports, and proprietary documentation with the highest level of confidentiality and professional integrity.
privacy_modal.p2: Any information submitted through our enquiry forms or consultation channels is used strictly for evaluating compliance advisory requirements and communicating with your authorised representatives.
privacy_modal.p3: We never sell, rent, or disclose client documentation or contact information to third parties without prior written consent.
